_read_me: Compact authoring example. NOT listed in index.json, so it never loads in play; tests/city_case_engine_smoke_runner.gd validates it so it stays correct. Copy it to cases/<id>.json, list it in index.json, replace every value, and drop status draft when the text is final.
_status: draft = loads and validates, never offered to players; ready = playable content
_template: a shape from templates/; the fields below override it by key, and by "id" inside stage/objective/topic lists
title: Example: the borrowed tools

reward._points: community points, paid once as money through progression.reward_case at the configured rate

discovery._givers: the template already names the owner as the giver

pointer_account.label: Where the mail carrier saw the caddy

objectives.objective: Ask the gardener what is missing
objectives.dialogue: Our tool caddy is gone. Could you ask around before anyone gets blamed?

objectives.objective: Ask the mail carrier where it went

topics.ask: Did you see a green tool caddy?
topics.answer: A volunteer set one down farther along Old York.

objectives.objective: Recover the caddy along Old York
objectives.dialogue: The caddy still holds the hand tools.
Everything's here. Glad we asked first.
